newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Souvenir maker Yip's Pota seen in HK$50 mln IPO.
newsitem.headline: Souvenir maker Yip's Pota seen in HK$50 mln IPO.

text.p: Souvenir manufacturer Yip's Pota Holdings Ltd is expected to raise HK$50 million through an issue of 50 million shares at HK$1.00 each in an initial public offer (IPO) later in January, market sources said on Friday.
The issue price is expected to represent a price to earnings multiple of about 6.7 times, they said, adding that the company had forecast earnings of about HK$28 million for fiscal 1997.
DBS Securities is expected to be the sponsor of the issue, sources said.
No further details were immediately available, they said.
